snippet.title: Esoteric Ebb | Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Five days before the first-ever election, somebody blows up a tea shop.

Nobody wants to touch this mystery with a 10-foot hole, and so they send you, the cleric and master of the esoteric, to find answers...

A new trailer for Esoteric Ebb, our upcoming CRPG inspired by the freedom of tabletop adventures. Become the most interesting player at the table and completely ruin your DM’s day. Wishlist now on Steam: https://bit.ly/ebb_storytrailer
